title_sq: Kodra e Diellit, Tirane, Dupleks per shitje
description_sq:
Dupleks per shitje tek Kodra e Diellit.
Eshte I organizuar ne nje sallon relativisht te madh, me nje hapsire goxha te bollshme kendin e kuzhines, dy dhoma gjumi dhe dy tualete.
Dupleksi eshte I mobiluar deri ne detaj, me nje mobilim modern bashkekohor!
Eshte I pajisur me nje sistem ngrohje/ftohje tavanor multisplit Daiken, divane duxiana dhe eshte e shtruar e tera me parket te cilesise se pare.

Dupleksi eshte I pajisur gjithashtu me ballkon edhe oborr.
Gjithashtu ne cmim perfshihet edhe nje post parkimi.
Per nje vizite tek prona, me kontaktoni!
title_en: Kodra e Diellit, Tirana, Duplex for sale
description_en: Duplex for sale in Kodra e Diellit. It is organized in a relatively large living room, with a pretty spacious kitchen corner, two bedrooms and two bathrooms. The duplex is furnished to the last detail, with modern contemporary furniture! It is equipped with a Daiken multisplit ceiling heating/cooling system, Duxiana sofas and it is all laid with first quality parquet. The bathrooms are equipped with underfloor heating, matrimonial rooms with large open wardrobes and bathtubs. All household appliances are super quality brands (Samsung / Electrolux / Bosch). The duplex is also equipped with a balcony and a yard. A parking space is also included in the price. For a visit to the property, contact me!
